name: Katei Kyoushi: Tutor privado
source:
Everything that looked like it was going to end in a bad day after a series of unfortunate events, suddenly got better when you found a beautiful girl crying on the floor.

[From [url=https://otaku-argento.itch.io/katei-kyoushi]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
接连的不幸让你以为，这注定会是糟糕的一天。然而，当你发现一位美丽的女孩坐在地上哭泣时，一切突然有了转机。

[摘自[url=https://otaku-argento.itch.io/katei-kyoushi]Itch.io[/url]]
